bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without warning
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing repayment results without warning
compound_interest allows negative principal with no validation, producing negative accumulated balances unless debt semantics are explicitly intended
transfer does not coerce or validate amount as Decimal, so float/invalid numeric inputs can raise TypeError or cause inconsistent behavior
transfer is not atomic: account_from.balance is debited before account_to.balance is credited, so a failure during the credit step can leave balances inconsistent
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the transaction amount
fx_convert does not validate that exchange rates are positive, finite, or nonzero, allowing negative/zero/invalid rates to create nonsensical converted amounts
